text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Today's straightaway time
was faster than yesterday's!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Growth is growth, even by a fraction of a second!
Let's keep this momentum and take it one step at a time tomorrow—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Complete—did the gap... close a little...?
However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Not yet. ...To live up to their expectations...
...I must reach—even greater heights."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer! Could we please continue training a little longer?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I need to push myself even more desperately and hungrily to improve and live up to everyone's expectations...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
choice_data_list: Let's rest today so we can keep moving forward step by step.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! Thank you so much!
That's so reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Traaaineeer!
How was that time just now!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Heh...
Seeing this... I can't afford to lose either.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Gah!!
Oh yeah, and I'm the one who said it in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Slow and steady, without rushing!
Treasure the growth you gained from today's training!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you very much.
I'll make sure to get plenty of rest and prepare for tomorrow!
